tldr: Under separate empirical third-half-moment budgets, the raw finite-cohort treatment effect has unrestricted minimax squared-risk order \(n^{-2/3}\). An exact labelled-record prior and an explicit nonlinear factual-record rule certify \(\mathsf L_4\le C\le2^{2/3}\), with \(\mathsf L_4>9/8\). A proved hidden-support transfer, using posterior allocation resampling, centered body compensation and an exchangeable-count comparison, yields \(0\le C-V_n\le185n^{-2/37}\) eventually. This all-design sharp-order and effective-stabilization theorem is the delivered contribution. Analytic evaluation of \(C\), optimal allocation, extremizers and an explicit sharp attainer remain residual questions.

Bounded causal saddles and classical fractional-budget summation also leave the evaluated scalar for \(\mathcal Y_n\) unresolved.
